target.title: Add PR 674 review reliability observability
target.body:
## Summary

Adds the review-reliability observation layer that must land before https://github.com/openclaw/clawsweeper/pull/674.

This PR intentionally starts from `main` and does **not** copy PR 674's generation-bound queue protocol or producer implementation. It establishes the backward-compatible storage, observer, aggregate API, dashboard card, health rules, and rollout contract that PR 674 can produce into after rebasing.

## What ships

- Extends durable per-item review telemetry with optional generation/operation identity, trigger attribution, terminal reasons/times, indexed outcomes, and phase durations while retaining v1 compatibility and full JSON records.
- Adds immutable run-level workflow telemetry plus a read-only `workflow_run` observer for completed `ClawSweeper` waves, including plan/item/publication job evidence and conservative terminal reconciliation.
- Adds a lease-aware watchdog for stale `refreshing` attempts. It lists orphans and rolls them into health; it only terminalizes when the workflow is confirmed terminal and no valid lease remains.
- Adds `GET /api/review-observability?range=6h|24h|7d&repo=all|owner/repo` with bounded outcome, coverage, percentile, lane, recovery, and anomaly aggregation.
- Adds the `Review reliability` dashboard card between Work execution and Exact Review, with hero roll-up through `review_execution_degraded` / `review_execution_critical`.
- Documents green/amber/red thresholds, passive rollout, canary checks, PR 674 integration, and non-disruptive rollback in `docs/pr-674-observation-runbook.md`.

## Passive rollout and PR 674 integration

Before v2 producers are enabled, the card deliberately displays `Awaiting v2 producers`; it does not claim green health from absent data.

After this PR lands, https://github.com/openclaw/clawsweeper/pull/674 should:

1. Rebase onto the resulting `main`.
2. Connect its exact-event and per-item matrix jobs to the durable producer endpoints at authoritative claim, queue/claim/review/publication transitions, and one immutable terminal outcome.
3. Supply generation and operation IDs plus the appropriate `trigger_lane`, `trigger_origin`, and terminal reason (`superseded/generation_superseded` versus unexpected `cancelled/workflow_cancelled`).
4. Keep telemetry writes warning-only so observability cannot block review execution.
5. Enable required enforcement with a 30-minute warm-up, then run the two-generation proposal-only canary and observe at least one hot-intake and normal-backfill cycle.

The observer remains independent of producer finalizers so plan failures, whole-workflow cancellation, and missing item telemetry remain visible. Normal backfill is evaluated separately and cannot be masked by exact-event or hot-intake success.

## Validation

- Node `v24.15.0`
- `pnpm run check`
- Focused dashboard/worker/telemetry/workflow tests (180 passing before the final full check)
- Autoreview via `/data/code/openclaw/openclaw/.agents/skills/autoreview/scripts/autoreview --mode local --stream-engine-output`
  - fixed the exact-1000-job pagination boundary
  - pinned privileged `workflow_run` checkout to the trusted default branch with persisted credentials disabled
  - rejected the stale `actions/checkout@v7` availability claim because this repository explicitly requires v7 and its checkout guard test passes

## Safety

This change does not pause the live sweep, run apply/close, mutate foreign pull requests, or enable PR 674's producer enforcement.
